title: Converge lifecycle truth core and end successor-chain deadlocks
rawUserRequest: 目标是，收敛方向，顺利完成本轮计划所有工单。我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的 Contract 里。不要采用临时修补方案；流程问题必须通过正式工单修正；所有 Outcome 必须持续显示红黄绿、失败 gate 和恢复条件。

declaredIntent.summary: From current main, provide one complete, installer-parity lifecycle truth implementation so every governed Work Item has durable Outcome, quality-attempt, amendment, supersession, successor, projection, diagnostic, and multilingual evidence rather than starting another corrective chain.

outOfScope: Copying, resuming, archiving, deleting, or editing any predecessor clone, linked worktree, branch-local Contract, Summary, Outcome, receipt, session, or archive evidence; those are read-only forensic sources.
Opening another P1 Issue for a verification-feedback failure inside this declared lifecycle, installer, generated-evidence, script, test, or documentation closure.
Changing product-specific adopter application code, external provider state, release publication, semantic tags, or GitHub branch-protection settings.
Weakening a lifecycle, ownership, quality, coverage, installer, pre-release, or multilingual gate; unsupported state must remain red or yellow with its actual recovery condition.

riskAssessment.reason: This Work Item changes the shared lifecycle truth boundary across source and installed adopters. A stale, mutable, missing, or mismatched receipt, projection, or generated document could allow an unverified change to appear complete or permanently deadlock recovery.

reasons: Lifecycle truth, installer parity, successor transitions, and pre-release documentation are release-blocking governance surfaces.

override.approvalEvidence: User authorization: execute the entire current plan autonomously and approve formal supersession/quarantine for convergence.
override.reason: Lifecycle truth, installer parity, successor transition, and pre-release evidence must be verified as one strict integration boundary.
notRunChecks: Provider publication is excluded from this Work Item and is not a required verification path.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized autonomous execution and the consolidated Issue predeclares the complete closure needed to repair in-scope verification feedback without a successor chain.

preReviewWarnings: Treat every predecessor branch, worktree, session, Outcome, Contract, Summary, and archive artifact as immutable forensic input; implement only from current main.
Test success and each early failure separately: no failed or blocked path may omit a red or yellow Outcome, failed gate, source-bound attempt receipt, and recovery condition.
Verify source-template and isolated installed-adopter behavior from the same runtime/catalog contract; do not declare parity from source-only tests.
Regenerate all affected English, Japanese, capability, and pre-release evidence through their canonical commands and retain their source bindings.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Shared lifecycle controls require an immutable pre-edit baseline and a final evidence review before archive.

acceptance: Every ai-finish success, validation failure, quality failure, and archive-recovery failure produces one validator-valid active Outcome with red/yellow/green machine color, failed gate or completion fact, actionable recovery condition, and deterministic English/Japanese projection.

The original before_edit checkpoint remains immutable while each permitted pre-verification Contract amendment appends a source-bound revalidation record; amendment attempts after verification begins fail closed without replacing prior evidence.

Every actual quality attempt, including successful and failed source or isolated-adopter runs, creates an immutable receipt bound to its Contract, base, candidate, command, result, and diagnostic evidence; reports cannot claim a quality result without that receipt.

A blocked Work Item can transition only through a formal superseded or quarantined record into a successor receipt that binds predecessor Outcome, Issue, branch, base, reason, authority, and immutable read-only predecessor evidence; unrelated Work Items remain fail closed.

The installer catalog, templates, distributed Make targets, runtime scripts, policies, and isolated-adopter tests provide the same lifecycle truth behavior as the source template and fail closed when a required component is missing or mismatched.

Canonical generators refresh all affected English and Japanese lifecycle guidance, capability truth, pre-release documentation, diagnostics, and status evidence, and executable checks reject stale, hand-authored, contradictory, or unsupported claims.
The complete strict quality suite, lifecycle gates, source-bound evidence checks, and isolated-adopter integration scenarios pass on the current-main integration branch before archive and review.
guidelines: Preserve fail-closed lifecycle behavior and immutable predecessor evidence; never hide a blocked state to start another Work Item.
Implement one source of lifecycle truth and project it into Outcome, status, doctor, receipts, installer, templates, and documentation rather than duplicating derived state.
Use red-first regression tests for each former deadlock and each failure Outcome before implementation changes.
Generate evidence-bearing documentation and capability projections only through canonical commands; do not hand-edit generated status or pre-release artifacts.
Keep English and Japanese human-facing semantics aligned while preserving machine identifiers, paths, commands, digests, and statuses exactly.

intent.problem: The current plan is expanding because interdependent lifecycle fixes were split across stale worktrees. Contracts lock before full verification dependencies are visible, failed quality attempts are not consistently represented as source-bound Outcomes, and no formal supersession path releases a genuinely blocked Work Item without mutating its history. Source behavior and installed-adopter behavior can then diverge, while generated Japanese and pre-release evidence is discovered too late.
constraints: Deliver the entire lifecycle, installer, generated-evidence, scripts, tests, policies, documentation, and archive closure from current main in this Work Item rather than opening another corrective chain for in-scope verification feedback.
Keep predecessor branches, linked worktrees, sessions, Outcomes, Contracts, Summaries, receipts, and archives read-only; cite immutable evidence rather than copying, moving, deleting, or resuming it.
Do not weaken any gate, fabricate a successful attempt, claim parity without isolated-adopter execution, or publish a release as part of this Work Item.
Ensure every status transition has a machine-readable source of truth and an English/Japanese reviewer projection with red, yellow, green, or unknown semantics.
Do not start another delivery unit until this Work Item has completed its merge and lifecycle closure.
intent.rationale: A single current-main implementation boundary removes overlapping edits and makes recovery evidence, installer behavior, and human review signals mutually verifiable. It is the shortest safe path from growing successor chains to a serially closable remaining plan.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An ai-finish path fails before normal completion because a lifecycle, quality, coverage, ownership, or archive prerequisite is absent.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A validator-valid red or yellow Outcome, bound quality-attempt receipt when applicable, failed gate, and specific recovery condition are written and projected in English and Japanese without archive authorization.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add red-first integration tests for each early failure class and assert Outcome, receipt, status, doctor, and archive fail-closed behavior.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Contract changes after before_edit and before quality verification starts.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The original checkpoint remains immutable, a digest-bound revalidation record appends, and an amendment after verification has started is rejected without history replacement.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add lifecycle receipt tests for permitted append-only revalidation, stale mismatch, and post-verification rejection.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Work Item is blocked by a valid active Outcome and needs a corrective successor.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Only a formally authorized superseded or quarantined transition can create a receipt-bound successor; unrelated starts, mutable predecessor evidence, and missing bindings fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add source and installed-adopter integration tests for blocked, superseded, quarantined, successor, and unrelated-start paths.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An adopter is installed from the template and executes lifecycle commands with a missing, stale, or mismatched distributed runtime component.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The installed adopter has source-equivalent commands and policies when complete, and otherwise fails closed with a diagnostic that identifies the missing component and recovery action.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend isolated-adopter installation and lifecycle tests for source parity, catalog completeness, missing scripts, Make targets, policies, and quality-attempt receipts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Lifecycle truth changes affect status, doctor, capability truth, or pre-release English/Japanese documentation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Canonical generation refreshes byte-bound evidence and all checks reject stale, hand-authored, contradictory, or unsupported source/template/adopter claims.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Regenerate the documented artifacts and add deterministic source-bound, multilingual, capability, and pre-release regression tests.
